answer: Work-slot deposit burning limits fake identities. Each agent burns a 20-unit deposit to claim one work slot for 20 epochs, its only way to earn. A slot may cover tending an orchard plot or monitoring a river gauge, so work is real and checked. Creating 100 fakes burns 2,000 units with no refund, so a rising tide of copies costs more than the reward they could split. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
